 This petition coming on for admission this day, Hon'ble   Ravi Malimath, Chief Justice passed the following:
 ORDER
The plea of the petitioners is that in spite of an award being passed by the respondents with regard to acquisition of land, payments have not been made.
Hence, the instant petition.
2. The learned counsel appearing for the National Highways Authority of India (NHAI) submits that an initial award has been made for the land that has been acquired.
The compensation has been paid to him.

The petitioners counsel submits that he has approached the Arbitrator under Section 3G(5)
of the National Highways Act, 1956 (hereinafter referred to as "the Act of 1956") seeking enhancement of compensation.

It is further submitted that the supplementary award has been passed in favour of the petitioners, which is challenged by the NHAI before the Arbitrator under Section 3G(5) of the Act of 1956 at Narsinghpur.
Therefore, until and unless the Arbitrator gives his opinion with regard to the supplementary award, no payment can be made.
That the same has been filed on 15.12.2022.
3. Under these circumstances, we do not find that any order could be passed in this petition.
The payment has already been made with respect to the initial award that has been passed.
The dispute is only with regard to the supplementary award.
Therefore, until and unless that is concluded, no payment can be made to the petitioners.
4. In view of the pendency of the matter before the Arbitrator, it is directed that the same may be decided as expeditiously as possible.
5. The writ petition is accordingly disposed off.

(RAVI MALIMATH) (VISH  CHIEF JUSTICE   irfan Malak Singh vs Union Of India on 13 February, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/151154200/
